vision.en: We adhere to stable private holding operation, improving four core capabilities including capital management, brand operation, industrial synergy and global localized management. We export local cultural works, premium plateau agricultural products and self-developed AI technologies via cross-border businesses to build an international industrial cluster with solid risk resistance.
